name: Disk space watch
desc: Checks every filesystem; flags any over 85% and what grew. Report only.
prompt: For each selected host, check disk use with the host.disk_usage probe (and get_host for the hub's disks). List every filesystem above 85% full, the largest consumers you can see (scan_disk on the hub for the fullest mount, docker.system_df where Docker runs), and whether anything grew fast. If nothing is above 85%, say so in one line. Keep the report short.
